title: Advanced Digital Marketing
overview: The Advanced Digital Marketing course equips participants with in-depth knowledge and advanced strategies across key areas of digital marketing. Building on existing experience, this course covers sophisticated techniques for social media, influencer marketing, search engine marketing, video, and email marketing. Participants will have the opportunity to apply what they learn to their own campaigns throughout the course, enhancing their skills in real-time.
audience: This course is designed for professionals in digital marketing, sales, media, web development, and management, as well as anyone with prior digital marketing experience who is looking to expand their expertise and elevate their digital marketing skills to an advanced level.
methodology: Highly interactive and hands-on, the course encourages participants to work on their own campaigns, applying advanced concepts and strategies as they progress.
competencies: Advanced search and display advertising strategies
Website critique and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Leverage advanced advertising techniques on social media platforms
Utilize advanced features for Google Paid Search and Display Ads
Design and manage impactful video marketing campaigns
Develop and optimize engaging email marketing campaigns
Understand and implement Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to enhance website performance
Analyze and optimize key digital marketing metrics along the marketing funnel
Harness the power of influencer and affiliate marketing for broader reach and impact
